intro: Lesson 19. Your partner ticks a box each time you do it in an answer (ABCD: Answer, Because, Contrast, Different time frame).

rows: A: a clear answer with an opinion
D: a different time frame (past or future)
Answered in the same tense as the question
Used a repair or time-buying phrase when needed
